description:
The Confluent Control Center will be deployed under the name **control‑center** using the “*” role and will run as the **nobody** user. Each instance is allocated 2 CPU shares and 4096 MB of memory, and we will start a single instance. The service will listen on **https** and uses the keystore secret **myKeystoreSecret**. Virtual networking is enabled; the instance will join the **dcos** virtual network and the plugin will receive two labels: **env=prod** and **team=analytics**. Security is configured with the following cipher suites: **TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA384**. The enterprise license key in use is **ABC123-XYZ789-TRIAL**. For internal Control Center topics we have configured 3 partitions with a replication factor of 2, and the monitoring‑interceptor topics use the same 3 partitions and replication factor of 2.

The Kafka back‑end is pointed at the bootstrap server **broker.confluent‑kafka.l4lb.thisdcos.directory:9092**, with client communication over **PLAINTEXT** using the **GSSAPI** SASL mechanism. The client SASL Kerberos service name is **kafka**, but Kerberos authentication is currently disabled. The associated Kerberos secrets are named **jaas**, **__dcos_base64___keytab**, and **krb5** for the JAAS config, keytab, and krb5 config respectively. Zookeeper connectivity is set to **master.mesos:2181/dcos-service-confluent-kafka**. Finally, the Connect service cluster is reachable at **connect1.marathon.l4lb.thisdcos.directory:8083,connect2.marathon.l4lb.thisdcos.directory:8083**.
